verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer docs describe a searchable, filterable reference for the full v2 REST API and a quickstart for making a first authenticated call. Nothing shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console, or that it has runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/console in the API reference, runnable code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
